name: Bergisel Ski Jumping
beschreibung: The Bergisel ski jump provides the iconic stage for the prestigious Four Hills Tournament (Vierschanzentournee). Thousands of spectators cheer on the world's elite ski jumpers as they soar into the depths from the renowned hill. A true winter sports highlight in Innsbruck.
kurzbeschreibung: World Cup ski jumping on Bergisel as part of the Four Hills Tournament – winter sports at their finest.
